name: campusconnect
description: CampusConnect: An Integrated College-to-Career Platform — From Campus Experience to Career Readiness

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@campusconnect/api & npm run dev --workspace=@campusconnect/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@campusconnect/shared && npm run build --workspace=@campusconnect/api && npm run build --workspace=@campusconnect/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build --workspace=@campusconnect/shared && npm run db:up && sleep 4 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@campusconnect/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@campusconnect/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@campusconnect/web
